kit.title: Community Pantry Shift Onboarding & Incident Escalation SOP Pack
kit.summary: Standalone SOP playbook and multilingual role-card drafting skill for volunteer coordinators, reserving all medical, safety, and accommodation decisions strictly for the on-site shift captain.
kit.target_org: Neighborhood mutual-aid pantry and cold-weather shelter

steps.title: Generate printable station checklists and shift handoff notes
steps.guidance: Prepare plain-language station cards (receiving, sorting, distribution, cleanup) with clear escalation contact boxes.

steps.title: Handle accommodation requests and volunteer conduct
steps.guidance: Any conflict or guest accommodation decision is handled in person by the trained shift captain.

steps.title: Execute live medical, weather, or physical safety response
steps.actor: On-site shift captain and certified first-aid lead
steps.guidance: Immediate physical safety or medical distress is handled directly by on-site human responders.

steps.title: Send approved shift schedule and emergency contacts to volunteers
steps.guidance: Coordinator reviews and sends shift packets directly; agents never message volunteers automatically.

skills.name: shift-role-card-drafter
skills.description: Drafts concise, accessible volunteer station cards and shift handoff checklists from a pantry or shelter's operating hours and station list.
skills.instructions: Format each station card at an 8th-grade reading level with three sections: Setup, During Shift, and When to Call the Shift Captain. Never generate medical advice or disciplinary decisions.
refuses: Making volunteer disciplinary or dismissal decisions
Generating clinical or emergency medical instructions

artifacts.name: shift_escalation_sop
artifacts.title: Three-Tier On-Site Escalation Playbook
artifacts.summary: Printable escalation tree distinguishing routine supply restocks from immediate human shift-captain and emergency-responder triggers.
spec: Tier 1 (Station Lead): Restock shortages, queue pacing, translation card lookup.
Tier 2 (Human Shift Captain -- immediate): Guest accommodation request, interpersonal dispute, minor facility hazard.
Tier 3 (Human Shift Captain + Local Emergency Services): Medical distress or immediate physical safety concern.

artifacts.name: station_handoff_template
artifacts.title: End-of-Shift Handoff CSV Template
artifacts.summary: Zero-PII station handoff log recording supply counts, equipment status, and open follow-ups for the next coordinator.

checklist: Confirm the on-site shift captain's name and phone extension are filled in before printing station cards.
Verify no guest or volunteer personal health details appear in shift handoff notes.
Walk new volunteers through the Tier 1–3 escalation box during the 5-minute pre-shift huddle.

sources.title: Sphere Handbook: Humanitarian Charter and Minimum Standards

fixtures.scenario: Saturday morning pantry coordinator preparing four station role cards
fixtures.sample_input: SYNTHETIC: 3-hour Saturday pantry shift with 12 volunteers across intake welcome, dry-goods table, cold storage, and exit carry-out.

fixtures.scenario: Guest requests urgent cold-weather shelter exception after hours
fixtures.sample_input: SYNTHETIC: Volunteer at welcome table asks how to handle an after-hours family shelter accommodation request.

review_notes: Verified custom step kind volunteer_roster_prep, standalone SOP + CSV artifacts without requiring an MCP server, and strict human_only captain escalation.
